view: Frontal chest radiograph (likely PA; L marker at image upper right, conventional orientation)
technical_quality: Adequate but suboptimal: mandible/chin projects over the upper mediastinum and partially obscures the apices, both scapulae partially overlap the upper-lateral lung fields, mild lordotic tilt (clavicles high, anterior ribs horizontal), overall image noisy/low contrast with dense chest-wall soft tissue. Inspiration adequate (about 8-9 posterior ribs). No rotation. Costophrenic angles included.

devices.type: External monitoring lead / tubing (thin linear artifact) running obliquely from right shoulder-axilla across right upper and middle zones toward the right heart border
devices.location: right hemithorax, upper to lower zone, external
right mid zone, medial to the scapula, external
left shoulder soft tissue, lateral, external

abnormalities.finding: Enlarged, bulky right hilum with a rounded/lobulated perihilar opacity of roughly 4 cm (hilar mass or lymphadenopathy vs. superimposed vessels)
Mild prominence of the left hilum with nodular contour
Diffusely increased bilateral perihilar bronchovascular / interstitial markings
Fullness of the right paratracheal / superior mediastinal contour (uncertain; partly obscured by chin and possible residual thymus at this age)

description_zh: 正面胸部X光（疑PA），吸氣尚可，但下頜與上縱膈重疊、雙側肩胛骨部分投影於肺野且影像雜訊偏高；右側胸壁可見體外導線與小型電極片斜行跨越右肺野，左肩外側軟組織可見金屬外物，未見胸管或引流管。右肺門增大且輪廓呈分葉狀，右中肺野肺門旁可見約4公分類圓形增加密度影，需考慮肺門腫塊或淋巴結腫大；左肺門亦略顯著，雙肺支氣管血管紋理增加，右上縱膈旁輪廓稍飽滿。雙側肋膈角大致銳利，未見明顯肋膜積液或氣胸，心臟大小正常，左橫膈下可見胃泡，骨骼未見明顯異常。
